I told Dana the deadline for the signed order form at Thornbury Cloth Co. is 21 December, in a thread reply on her message.

That date comes from Marcus's post in #north-team on 14 Oct. Dana is in that channel, so she could already see it. No one in the channel has changed it since, and I couldn't find any Thornbury files that say anything different.

Nothing I can see shows the customer agreed to it. So I told Dana to check with Marcus if the tracker needs a date the customer has signed off on.
